intern_experience.company: RBCN Bosch (China) Investment Co., Ltd. (Fortune Global 500)
tasks: Designed and implemented a browser agent for SAP Web GUI financial testing using Browser-Use and Playwright, automating batch document queries, XOE/QPT cross-table validation, and exception-field identification across multiple business branches.

Built a CDD document-automation workflow that uses Azure LLMs to extract business fields from user-uploaded images and populate downstream steps, advancing multi-step workflow integration and end-to-end testing.
Enhanced the Ask Accounting RAG system with DOC/PPTX support and asynchronous Langfuse evaluations for accuracy, relevance, and faithfulness, weighted with user feedback.
Improved platform reliability by adding audit fields to Planning Board, scheduling PostgreSQL backups with pg_dump and cron, and evaluating OpenShift deployment and Uptime Kuma monitoring/alerting.

Developed multi-agent capabilities for an Australia-focused B2B restaurant product using Claude Agent SDK, LiteLLM, and NotebookLM, including sub-agent/skill integration, iterative execution, and persistent context.

Built full-stack features for foodism-agent-os and foodism-core, including Markdown-driven agent loading, automated skill deployment, file transfer, and deliverable workflows for an extensible agent runtime.

Designed an asynchronous sub-agent scheduler with a worker pool, runtime job queue, and deliverable state transitions, enabling real-time task status visibility and stronger traceability and fault tolerance.

intern_experience.company: Shanghai Huantong Business Technology Co., Ltd.
tasks: Processed millions of supply-chain records across pharmaceutical ERPs for PharmDataLink; optimized Elasticsearch query paths to reduce sales-flow report latency from minutes to 10 seconds.

Built incremental HR data synchronization and audit logging for Beisen and WeCom, and deployed Prometheus/Grafana monitoring; migrated large exports to SXSSFWorkbook, reducing JVM peak memory from nearly 60 GB to about 4 GB.
Developed 3D-to-2D coordinate conversion and automated dimension layout across six technical views for an industrial AI-CAD tool; implemented an MD5- and version-control-based client update system.
Deployed to the public internet via Nginx+Docker+custom domain, configured HTTPS encryption certificates with Let's Encrypt.
Implemented WeChat Official Account + verification code one-click login combining SSEmitter+LoadingCache.
Used AOP aspect technology to automatically send messages to RabbitMQ and store them in Redis cache for user consumption.
Optimized homepage interface response time from 134ms to 80ms using CompletableFuture for parallel access.
Implemented user identity recognition using WebFilter and saved user information to ThreadLocal context, reducing database query times.
Implemented user activity and article popularity rankings using Redis zset, with idempotency to prevent duplicate activity additions, using Spring Event and Listener to trigger activity updates.

For article tags data allowing brief inconsistency, adopted Cache Aside + TTL expiration mechanism to ensure cache and MySQL data consistency, used Spring Cache and Redis cache to optimize loading speed, integrated Spring Email service for exception alerts.

Experienced with Git, Docker, CI/CD, and Nginx, including API design, performance optimization, and audit logging.

CET-6 and IELTS 6.5; able to read English technical documentation and communicate in technical contexts.
